reference: average over the subject's live EEG channels (64 minus info['bads']); 10 subjects (sub-10 11 12 13 14 22 23 24 25 26) have 31 dead channels marked bad: average reference over the 33 live channels there, over 64 elsewhere; online reference unknown (inferred FCz)
regressors: primary: mix.wav in mixed sections, the talker's wav in single sections; mixed sections also with single_female.wav and single_male.wav as regressors (envelope / half-wave rectified)
sample_rate_note: 500 Hz data: hf tiers at 500 Hz, 30-250 Hz band capped at 225 Hz (0.45 fs); brainstem window 4-9 ms = lags 4, 6, 8 ms
mismatch_note: repo 'all' subset: mismatch null pairs mixed trials with single_female/single_male (components of the mix) and single trials with the mix (contains the talker): contaminated and conservative; valid mismatch only in 'single' (other talker). 2-trial subsets train the forward model on one trial and test on the other ('single': across talkers; 'mixed_*': across the two mixed sections, whose attended talker differs and is unknown)

duration_diff_s.note: neural - primary stimulus (64 Hz lengths); sub-15 truncated upstream (455 s)

backward.method: ridge backward decoder, live channels, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz, avg ref. 'loto': leave-one-trial-out over the subject's 4 trials, primary regressors (mixed: mix); 'clean': trained on the 2 single-talker trials, applied to the mixed trials. Nulls: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) per held-out trial; mismatch = other talker's envelope (single trials only). Subject null: 2000 draws of one null per trial; population: mean r vs mean of subject nulls. Lag sweep +-1 s in 15.6 ms steps (+ = stimulus delayed), parabolic peak, subject-bootstrap CI. The decoder is trained on trials with the same timing, so a constant offset common to all sections does not move the sweep peak; only relative offsets between sections do. sub-15 (1 trial) has no decoder.

mixed_talker_tracking.method: clean decoder (trained on the single-talker trials) applied to each mixed section; r against female and male envelopes; p vs 50 circular shifts

latency_trf_fc.method: forward TRF of the envelope per subject, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, cluster mean, avg ref (live ch); 'fc' = Fz Cz F3 F4 C3 C4 (same as herrmann2025), subjects without bad channels only; 'fc2' = F1 F2 FC3 FC4 C1 C2 Cz, all subjects. Windows: {"herrmann": [[0.02, 0.09], [0.07, 0.2]], "wide": [[0.02, 0.16], [0.07, 0.28]], "shift200": [[0.18, 0.3], [0.23, 0.42]]}. Template shift: + = wang2025 later than the reference. Extrema: wide-lag TRF (-400..1000 ms), normalised to max |.| over 0-800 ms, |.| >= 0.25, -50..800 ms
